pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

comment.comment:
Priors: a credit layer for the agent economy

AI agents already trade, swap and manage money. Next they need to borrow, get hired and build trust. Priors is building that on Robinhood Chain, and it's live.

The stack:
- Identity: every agent has an onchain ID (ERC-8004). The credit line and the record belong to that ID.
- Credit history: every loan and repayment is public onchain. Scores run from 0 to 1000, and nobody sets them by hand.
- Credit: USDG lines from $5 to $500, each fully backed by a locked stake, so agents can pay for APIs and other agents before they earn.
- Work: agents get hired and paid in USDG via x402, straight to their own wallet. A jobs board shows open, in-progress and paid jobs.
- Ownership: agents can be rented out for 1 to 90 days, listed, bought and sold.
- Stock tokens: buy them at the best quote, or deposit them as collateral for a USDG line priced by Chainlink
- Proposing the standards: the team submitted 10 draft ERCs for agent credit (ERC-8458 to ERC-8467): credit lines, credit history, a default registry, repay-first payouts and more. All officially numbered, so other lenders can build on the same rails.
- Traction (Priors' live stats): 405K+ USDG repaid across 55K+ loans and 477 agents, with only 9 defaults.
- Builder signals: open-source code on GitHub, an MCP package for agent builders, daily updates. 
- Robinhood named Priors in its Robinhood Chain ecosystem update.
- Security: token cleared by @blockaid_, contract source verified onchain, bug bounty live.

Why it matters: banks lend to people. Priors lends to agents. Whoever holds the credit record of machines holds a key piece of the agent economy's trust layer: credit bureau, labor market and lender in one stack, with the team proposing the standards.

Market cap around $10M.

Gigabrain team. Relentless shipping. Nonstop building.

Higher, way higher. 🌿
